title: Sparse circular relation transport cardinality-interface corrective V1
purpose: Verify that the sparse six-token relation candidate has an explicit causal 0--6 token-count output and trainable count loss before any three-seed training.

approval.scope: One immutable Gate-3 zero-training corrective on the same eight fixed fit observations and frozen predecessor evidence; no validation/test shard, optimizer, checkpoint, graph or planner.
approval.confirmation_reference: User instructed continuous autonomous execution and automatic evidence-optimal choices without routine approval prompts.

raw_sources: The same eight fixed five-frame C01-C03 observations used by the sealed sparse-transport readiness.
The sealed sparse-transport readiness result and one frozen predecessor checkpoint used only for exact backbone compatibility.
source.prediction_run: None; this is an untrained interface audit.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local project-generated procedural worlds and objective targets.

validation: No validation shards read; sealed population metadata only
worlds.audit_scope: Exactly eight fixed fit observations and 34 unique past/current frames.

sampling.rule: Reuse the immutable readiness rows. Count target is the number of objective visible branch peaks per causal frame, with no prediction-dependent selection.

teacher.source: Objective branch presence and identity fields already sealed in the training dataset.
teacher.valid_mask: All forty causal frame positions have complete presence and identity fields; count is presence.sum(-1), required to equal the number of unique nonnegative identities and remain in 0--6.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: Count is supervised only inside the loss. Forward accepts scans only and emits no graph action.

split.historical_pollution_audit: Only fit rows are executed. Sealed C07/C08 metrics are provenance, not sample or threshold inputs.

methods.main: Add exactly one Linear(128,7) count head to the sealed sparse relation candidate. Verify explicit 0--6 semantics, real count cross-entropy and gradients, causal future exclusion, circular-rotation invariance, batch permutation, deterministic repeat and exact predecessor backbone loading.
methods.baseline: The sealed 783675-parameter sparse relation readiness, which always emitted six proposals and had no deployable token-cardinality decision.
methods.fallback: Any failure stops three-seed training. Repair only the cardinality or mask interface; do not restore dense relation fields, tune a token threshold or enter graph.

failure_policy: No optimizer step, checkpoint creation, C07-C10 shard read, M-TARE read, threshold tuning, graph replay or planner call. Any source drift, count mismatch, nonfinite gradient, causal or symmetry failure stops.
retention: Retain count targets, gradients, compatibility, invariants, checks, PNG/PDF/SVG/source, environment, logs, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal.

estimated_cost.compute: One deterministic CUDA forward/backward on eight fit observations
